title: 99Fletching - King of The Hill AI Generated Show - Arlen AI
author: fisj

comments.author: fisj
comments.body: There's not a lot of discussion (that I've seen) on how these infinite TV streams are done, but I think they're probably state of the art right now. Lots of gaming technologies fused with AI to get these results. I'd love to see a breakdown on how these are made by someone who is working on these.
